<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Unbind source device function points"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/virtual-devices/points/unbind"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Unbind source device function points from the custom virtual device. This does not affect the original source device.
`deviceId` refers to the virtual custom device ID. `sourcePoints` locates the already bound source function points,
and either `traitCode` or `commandCode` must be present (choose one of the two).
